record.question: Which among the following correctly defines Global 200?
options: An annual list of top ranking 200 companies released by Forbes Magazine
List of 200 World Heritage Sites released by UNESCO
List of 200 Cities which are of strategic importance by UNO
List of 200 Ecoregions identified by the WWF for conservation
record.answerKeyRef: MCS Combined 2023 Preliminary Exam Answer Key Paper-I Series 'A'..pdf
record.explanation: Global 200 is WWF’s conservation-priority framework for outstanding ecoregions, so the option linking ecoregions, WWF and conservation identifies the intended initiative. It is not a company ranking, a UNESCO World Heritage list or a list of strategic cities. “Global 200” is the initiative’s name, not a precise census: WWF’s own report lists 238 ecoregions. Learn the organisation and conservation purpose rather than treating the rounded number in the printed option as an exact total.
